data.one_liner: Type-safe Firestore ODM for Flutter and Dart with code generation.
data.what_it_does: Generates typed queries, updates, aggregates, transactions, and streams for Firestore documents based on model descriptions. It provides compile-time safety for fields, filters, and partial updates while keeping runtime performance close to raw cloud_firestore.
use_when: You want type-safe queries and partial updates for Cloud Firestore
You need fast build-time code generation for your Firebase data models
avoid_when: You use backend platforms other than Cloud Firestore
You prefer writing raw string-based Firestore queries without code generation
strengths: Typed filters, ordering, nested fields, and aggregations
Fast build times compared to legacy alternatives
Built-in support for transactions, batches, and subcollections
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation after model edits
Experimental features like Firestore Pipelines require an Enterprise database
data.setup_notes: Requires adding firestore_odm, cloud_firestore, and firebase_core, plus dev dependencies firestore_odm_builder and build_runner, followed by running code generation.
